How to Use v3
🚀 Five Steps to Run

nodes.title: 🚀 Five Steps to Run
widgets_values:
> 🎯 Give it a **character image** and an **original video**: the person in the video becomes your character. It can also do **motion transfer**. The AI writes all prompts and settings into a shot md; you only **pick the resolution and click Run**.

### ① 🤖 Let an AI write the md
Send the original video and the character image to an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex…) with the `feihou-h3-motion-ultra` skill installed (see the `skills` folder of this repo). Answer its questions and it writes a **shot md**.

### ② 🖼️ Put the media in the Media node
Video 1 = original video, image 1 = character image. A face close-up or a scene image goes to image 2, 3, in the same order as the md header.

### ③ 📄 Drag the md onto Shot Prompts
Drag the md onto the node, or click the md file button. After editing the md, click **refresh prompts**.

### ④ 📐 Setup: only pick the resolution
Aspect ratio, prompt and length all come from the md.

### ⑤ ▶️ Click Run once
Each segment queues the next one automatically; when all are done the **Final Video** node outputs the joined video.

| 🚫 Turbo LoRA | **leave it out** |
| 👣 Steps | 6 / 4 / 2 |

🔁 Stopped Midway / Not Happy

nodes.title: 🔁 Stopped Midway / Not Happy
widgets_values:
- ⏸️ **Stopped midway**: change nothing and click Run again; it carries on and still joins the full video at the end.
- 😕 **Not happy** (face not alike, lips off, her mouth moves when someone else talks, subtitles left): send the result back to the AI and say what is wrong; it fixes the md. Then click **refresh prompts** and run again.
- 🎬 **Rerun only some shots**: set start on Shot Prompts to 手动设置 (manual) and enter `3`, `3-5` or `6,9`.

💾 Out of VRAM

nodes.title: 💾 Out of VRAM
widgets_values:
- 📉 Lower the Setup **resolution** one step.
- ✂️ Ask the AI to lower `chunk` in the md's `@segment` (30 → 20).
- ☁️ If your GPU still can't handle it, use a cloud platform from **Run Online** on the right.

nodes.title: ⚠️ Notes
widgets_values:
- 🎞️ Long videos keep their quality thanks to **context windows**: for one-take videos or videos with few cuts, pick "long video with no (or few) cuts" in the skill.
- 🔄 After updating the nodes, **restart ComfyUI** and refresh the browser.
- 🛠️ A Sage Attention error while sampling: **update KJNodes** to the latest version.
